rules.name: Call for Back-up
rules.description: Depending on the size of the game a certain number of units maybe be taken as reinforcements. These units do not count toward force org and start the game in reserve even if the mission does not normally allow this special rule. They will enter play from the Arbities table edge or a random table edge if the Arbities player had no starting edge

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Assault 1, May reroll missed to hit rolls

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Assault 1, if the target is hit instead of rolling wound the target makes one armor save or becomes pinned. Open topped vehicles hit by this roll a d6 and on a 1 take a glancing hit rolled on a d3. Units that can't be pinned are immune./ Assault 1. This grenade only affects vehicles. When one is hit roll 1d6. 1= no effect, 2-5= glancing hit, 6 = penetrating hit

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Assault 1, blast, This weapon may not cause any wound but instead as long one wound is suffered the unit is Pinned. Open topped vehicles hit by this roll a d6 and on a 1 take a glancing hit rolled on a d3. Units immune to pinning are immune to this./ Assault 1, barrage, place a 5" circle of smoke. LOS may not be dawn through this and it lasts until the start of the Arbities player next turn. No barrage Pinning checks

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Heavy 1, Use Strength instead of Toughness to determine wounds, Units with melee weapons that modify their strength get the bonus. Vehicles must take a difficult terrain test, open-topped vehicles must take two, weapon crews may not fire the following turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: model gains +1 toughness, a twin linked boltgun, and becomes a mounted unit

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this model is slain lay it face down. At the start of its next turn roll 1d6 if the result is a 6 then stand the model up with 1 wound remaining. This can stand the model back up into close combat in which case neither side counts as having charged

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per turn when a squard with a comm link tests morale they may use a HQ with a comm link leadership for the test instead.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: All Arbite units within 12" of this model may always test to regroup even if below 50% strength, out of coherency, or with 6" of an enemy model

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Reroll one missed to hit roll

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Give the unit Feel no pain as long as the model with this wargear is alive

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Gives the model a 5+ inv save

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is alive their squad counts as having scored an additional hit in close combat for the purposes of resolution. In addition friendly units with 12" may reroll failed Pinning or Morale Checks

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: After infiltration deployment is done roll 4d6 for this model. If a unit was placed within that range this model may make a ranged attack targeting that unit following all normal ranged attack rules. This attack can cause the target to fall back or become pinned

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Allowed to premeasure ranges before making a attack

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In melee this model may make a single attack. This grenade only affects vehicles. When one is hit roll 1d6. 1= no effect, 2-5= glancing hit, 6 = penetrating hit

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this unit is in close combat enemy units subtract one from their initiative value

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this unit assaults a enemy unit the defending unit half (rounded down) its initiative value for the first round of combat

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A power weapon but rolls of 6 to hit wound automatically. A roll of a 6 on armor penetration rolls get a extra d6

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Close combat weapon but 6's to hit will auto wound and ignore armor saves

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: +1 to models armor save and counts as a close combat weapon

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Arbites players turn this model will regain 1 lost wound. Can not affect dead models

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
In close combat this model makes one addition Strength 4 attack at initiative 6
After infiltration deployment is done roll 4d6 for this model. If a unit was placed within that range this model may make a ranged attack targeting that unit following all normal ranged attack rules. This attack can cause the target to fall back or become pinned

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Heavy 1, Twin-Linked, Use Strength instead of Toughness to determine wounds, Units with melee weapons that modify their strength get the bonus. Vehicles must take a difficult terrain test, open-topped vehicles must take two, weapon crews may not fire the following turn. Any unit hit by thus weapon must take a Pinning test even if they are normally immune (use LD 10 for units without a stated leadership)

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Models no longer counts as open-topped

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A model attempting death or glory must first test initiative. If they fail they may not conduct the attack but are otherwise unharmed. All models attempting death or glory must declare before dice are rolled

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Crew stunned results count as crew shaken instead

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Reroll one reserve roll per turn while this model is on the battlefield

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the vehicle is destroyed roll d3 and place that many crew members within 2" of the vehicle. The models are armed with Laspistols and Lasrifles and use the stats for a Arbitrator. They form a new unit that counts as below half strength for morale, table quarters, etc. The unit itself is not worth any kill points but the vehicle counts as only damaged for victory points purposes if the crew survives

characteristics.name: Type
characteristics.$text: Heavy 3, A unit must take a Pinning test after being hit by this weapon even if they normally would be immune to such tests (use LD 10 for those with no LD stated). Open-topped vehicles hit roll a d6 for each hit and on a 1 suffer a d3 result on the glancing hit table. All other vehicle types are unaffected.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This models max speed is 6" but it rerolls difficult terrain tests

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Treat immobilised results as crew stunned on a d6 roll of a 4+ instead

rules.name: None Shall Pass
rules.description:
The Arbite may reroll its seize the initiative roll but must accept the second result. 


The Arbite player may choose to be defender instead of rolling off for any mission where attacker and defender are designations

rules.name: Inspired Leadership
rules.description: Any Arbities units with 12" make all Morale and pinning checks using his Leadership.

rules.name: Living legend
rules.description: Any Arbities units with LOS to a Judge may make all Morale and pinning checks using his Leadership. However if he is slain all Arbities units within LOS must make a morale check or fall back

rules.name: Superior training
rules.description: Sniper Teams never take morale checks for casualties and are immune to the Last Man Standing tests

rules.name: Shield wall
rules.description: At the end of the movement phase this unit may choose to form a shield wall if not in close combat. Until the start of the players next turn the unit receives a 5+ cover save and strikes first against opponents tied for inititaive. However they may not move of assault and if moved the unit loses this bonus

rules.name: Extreme Ferociousness
rules.description: The Kaynine models may never enter a transport

rules.name: Kayninez
rules.description: Kayninez move 6" as normal but may choose to assault 12" (if assaulting through difficult terrain roll 2d6 and double the highest for movement). This means the handler may be left behind. If you assault a unit beyond 6" then the handler may not fight in this round of close combat as he is trying to catch up. He may still take damage in this round though.

rules.name: Always pursue if not restrained
rules.description: This unit will always try to pursue a unit when it fall backs unless a successful leadership test can be made

rules.name: Handler
rules.description: As long as the handler is alive any morale checks the unit is forced to make are made at his leadership. However any wargear that provide bonus or rerolls on morale tests must be measured to him not the hounds. Negative effects still can be measured to the kaynines. If the handler is dead the next time this unit fails a leadership check of any kind the remaining kaynines are removed
